== Build notes: 2008 consolation and historical source copies ==

Added the Saturday consolation finish of 22nd, marked dropped, on 5 January 2008 with the format [[Premiere - Original VS14]].<ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=18352#p255191 Saturday consolation results], Players Committee Forums, numbered standings.</ref> Existing results, deck links and categories are retained.

The existing 2026 Day 1 finish of 16th is now cited to the explicit final standings in post 1449705, which prints "#16 Joe Pinto 6".<ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86887#p1449705 Final Day 1 standings], Players Committee Forums.</ref> The PC page's Day 1 deck list confirms AOBS/Legend but is unnumbered; its list position was not used to establish the finish. The complete nine-post standings thread was checked. A cached historical PNG of the same table was recovered and independently backed; its current download endpoint returned 403, so fresh original-byte equality has not been claimed. The article cites the current primary post's literal standings text.

=== Historical download provenance still unresolved ===
The previous 2012 and 2013 PC download-origin byte identities remain unverified. Those links have been replaced with the actual readable historical Wiki copies after checking Joe's sheets directly: 2012 p. 120 and 2013 p. 72.<ref>[[:File:2012 Match Play Championship Day 1.pdf|2012 Day 1 historical decklist copy]], p. 120.</ref><ref>[[:File:2013 Match Play Championship.pdf|2013 historical decklist copy]], p. 72.</ref> This identifies the copies that were read; it does not assert that their bytes equal a currently inaccessible earlier download. The original paths remain in the [[Special:PermanentLink/203906|pre-edit revision]] and its independently preserved exact source/provenance ledger. These two original-origin gaps remain open.

The general 2009 forum index was retained under External links. The existing Day 2 row now cites the proven original 2009 PDF, page 91, which names Joe and starts with Endor Operations. The source catalogue heading is now External links.

Checked sources, exact drafts/live content and native File versions have independent backups and central records. The exact pre-edit revision and provenance ledger are independently backed as well. Captures remain pending under the existing owner; this is publication eligibility, not preservation completion.

== Possibly faulty data: decklist positions and tournament finishes ==

The earlier 2017 and 2018 MPC finishes of 48 and 39 were positions in surname-alphabetical Day 1 deck lists, not numbered standings. Those finish cells are now blank; the event participation and deck links remain.<ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/match-play-championship/ 2017 MPC], Players Committee, Day 1 deck list.</ref><ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-match-play-championships/ 2018 MPC], Players Committee, Day 1 deck list.</ref>

The earlier 2015 MPC 41, 2016 MPC 31 and 2016 Worlds 32 also matched positions in unnumbered deck lists. These lists are not alphabetical, but do not explicitly label those positions as final standings. The finish cells have therefore been left blank pending a numbered result or other direct placing evidence.<ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-match-play-championship/ 2015 MPC], Players Committee, Day 1 deck list.</ref><ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-match-play-championship/ 2016 MPC], Players Committee, Day 1 deck list.</ref><ref name="joe-worlds2016-stage">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-world-championships/ 2016 Worlds], Players Committee, separate Day 1 and Day 2 lists.</ref> The old values remain in [[Special:PermanentLink/332482|revision 332482]] and its independently backed exact text. An unnumbered list does not establish that those finishes were false; it does not establish them as true either.

=== 2016 Worlds stage needs a direct source check ===
The current event index places Joe's AOBS/WHAP decks in its Day 1 list and does not include him in the eight-person Day 2 list.<ref name="joe-worlds2016-stage" /> The existing linked deck articles call them Day 2 and cite individual PC post locators whose titles also say Day 2. Those historical individual post bodies have not yet been recovered for this check. The profile's existing Day 2 label and deck article links are retained pending resolution; its former 32 was an ordinal in the index's Day 1 list, so it is not a supported Day 2 placing. No deck articles have been renamed or silently changed.

The existing 2018 Worlds 44 and 2025 Morristown 21 are explicitly numbered in their primary lists, and remain unchanged.<ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-world-championships/ 2018 Worlds], Players Committee, Day 2: 44) Joe Pinto.</ref><ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-02-morristown-melee-morristown-new-jersey-apr-24-27-2025/ 2025 Morristown Melee], Players Committee, Day 1: #21 Joe Pinto.</ref> The separately verified 2026 finish of 16 is also retained. The earlier preservation notes and all other content remain intact. This is a source-accuracy follow-up to the first incremental #722 publication, not a claim that all nine profiles or all source conflicts are complete.
